title: "Data dictionary"

All files are in the `data/` folder of the workshop project. You can also download them directly: [sim_correlation.csv](../data/sim_correlation.csv) · [sim_contrast.csv](../data/sim_contrast.csv) · [sim_tree.tre](../data/sim_tree.tre) · [sim_spatial_arr.csv](../data/sim_spatial_arr.csv) · [sim_truth.csv](../data/sim_truth.csv) · Excel: [correlation template](../excel/correlation_template.xlsx), [contrast template](../excel/contrast_template.xlsx).

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
pacman::p_load(tidyverse)

# Show the first 4 rows of a data file as a table
show_head <- function(file) {
  read.csv(here::here("data", file)) %>%
    head(4) %>%
    knitr::kable()
}
```

## Simulated datasets (hands-on activities)

Generated by `scripts/simulate_data.R` (seed 22). True parameter values are stored in `data/sim_truth.csv` so you can check whether your models recover them.

### `sim_correlation.csv` – 50 correlations between metabolic rate and performance

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `study_ID` | study identifier (22 studies) |
| `study_year` | publication year |
| `taxa` | Fish, Amphibian, Reptile, Bird, Mammal |
| `species` | species name, matching the tip labels in `sim_tree.tre` |
| `trait` | performance / behavioural trait correlated with metabolic rate (sprint speed, endurance, exploration, activity) |
| `sex` | female or male |
| `body_size` | mean body mass of the sample (g) |
| `comparison_ID` | correlations measured on the same sample of animals share an ID |
| `r` | Pearson correlation coefficient |
| `sample_size` | number of animals |

```{r}
#| echo: false
show_head("sim_correlation.csv")
```

### `sim_contrast.csv` – 50 warming vs control comparisons

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `study_ID`, `study_year`, `taxa`, `species`, `sex`, `body_size` | as above |
| `trait` | resting metabolic rate, maximum metabolic rate or heart rate |
| `comparison_ID` | effect sizes sharing the **same control group** share an ID |
| `control_mean`, `control_sd`, `control_n` | control group mean, SD and sample size |
| `treatment_mean`, `treatment_sd`, `treatment_n` | warmed group mean, SD and sample size |

```{r}
#| echo: false
show_head("sim_contrast.csv")
```

### `sim_tree.tre` – phylogeny

Newick tree of the 15 vertebrate species used in both simulated datasets, with branch lengths equal to approximate divergence times (millions of years; for teaching only – use TimeTree or published phylogenies for real analyses). Prune it to the species present in a dataset with `ape::keep.tip()`.

### `sim_spatial_arr.csv` – 40 populations with coordinates

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `study_ID`, `site_ID` | study and population identifiers |
| `longitude`, `latitude` | decimal degrees (south is negative) |
| `n_low`, `n_high` | sample sizes at the low and high acclimation temperature |
| `ARR`, `V_ARR` | acclimation response ratio of CTmax and its sampling variance |

### `sim_truth.csv`

The parameter values used in the simulation (`b0` = intercept, `b_male` = male–female difference, `b_mass` = slope per log~10~ g, `b_year` = slope per year, `s2_*` = variance components, `ln_cvr` = true lnCVR).

## Real datasets (worked examples on the lecture pages)

The lecture pages download these datasets directly from the authors' public repositories with `read.csv()`. Local copies of most of them are included in `data/` for offline use (redistributed for teaching; please cite the original papers).

| Local copy | Source | Used on |
|---|---|---|
| `wu_seebacher_2022_correlation.csv` | @WuSeebacher2022; individual-level correlations between physiology and activity/exploration/dispersal (`ind_disp_raw_data.csv`) | Effect sizes; Fixed, random & multilevel models; Heterogeneity; Non-independence; Meta-regression |
| `wu_seebacher_2022_core_edge.csv` | @WuSeebacher2022; means, SDs and *N* of range-core vs range-edge populations (`pop_disp_raw_data.csv`) | Effect sizes; Variability & location-scale |
| `rodgers_2021_diving_lab.csv` | @Rodgers2021; dive duration of ectothermic vertebrates at two temperatures (`contrast_lab_dataset.csv`) | Effect sizes; Meta-regression; Phylogenetic & spatial |
| `rodgers_2021_diving_lab_tree.nwk` | time-calibrated phylogeny for the dive data [@Rodgers2021] (`phylo_lab.nwk`) | Meta-regression; Phylogenetic & spatial |
| `arnold_2021_mr_fitness.csv` | @Arnold2021; correlations between resting metabolic rate and fitness (`MR_Fitness_Data_revised.csv`) | Publication bias |
| – (download only) | @Raynal2022; offspring mass under fluctuating vs constant incubation temperatures (`Mass.data.csv`) | Non-independence |
| – (download only) | @Pottier2021; acclimation response ratios of heat tolerance (OSF) | Effect sizes; Fixed, random & multilevel models; Heterogeneity |

## Excel files (Activity 1)

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `excel/correlation_template.xlsx` | correlation data with empty columns for Zr, its variance and SE |
| `excel/correlation_solution.xlsx` | the same with Excel formulas filled in |
| `excel/contrast_template.xlsx` | contrast data with empty columns for lnRR, its variance and Hedges' g |
| `excel/contrast_solution.xlsx` | the same with Excel formulas filled in |
